name: Nabuchodonosor
description: Named with Assuerus as the one by whom Nineve was taken, at the end of Tobit's life; the text gives no other detail. Left as a separate identity from Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians in the book of Judith and from Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon in 2 Kings: an open identity question for the owner

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
